lesson.title: 7.7 Invitations and Responses
lesson.unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
lesson.unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson.lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
lesson.goal: Invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's ..., and accept or decline with OK, Yes, thank you or Sorry, no.
lesson.grammar_function: Do you want to read? Let's watch TV. OK. Let's play on Saturday.
lesson.prerequisite: 4.8 Do you ...?; 5.6 want; 5.10 Yes, please and No, thank you; 6.7 Sorry, no.; 4.9 days; 7.6 activities.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Invite a friend and answer an invitation.
